title: Seven injured in gas cylinder explosion at Polonnaruwa Nephrology Hospital
byline: At least seven employees were injured and admitted to the Polonnaruwa General Hospital following a gas cylinder explosion in the kitchen of the Polonnaruwa National Nephrology Hospital.

title: Flood warnings extended for Gin and Nilwala river basins
byline: The Irrigation Department has extended the flood warnings issued for the Gin Ganga and Nilwala River Basins for another 24 hours.

title: England change ODI squad before Sri Lanka decider
byline: England have called up Dan Lawrence to replace Jos Buttler for the third and final ODI against Sri Lanka at The Kia Oval today, September 27, with the three-match series level at 1-1.
